filters.basis: The table holds 19 galaxies; these are the rows of NGC3627.

frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc the image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: The stellar disc's exponential scale height as its scale length over 7.3, the mean flattening Kregel et al. (2002) measured for edge-on discs, with S4G's disc scale length (Salo et al. 2015), 53.95″ = 2.70 kpc: 370 pc. For young objects it is an upper value. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

meaning: Supernova remnants of M66 that Scheuermann et al. (2022) separated from its planetary nebulae by their line ratios: one dot per remnant at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the supernova-remnant color M31's and M33's dots share. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
